components.name: Gold Primary Button
components.description: Highest-priority action on dark institutional surfaces.
components.css: .ds-btn-gold { display: inline-block; background: var(--color-gold, #C5A55A); color: var(--color-navy, #0A1F3F); padding: 12px 32px; border-radius: 6px; font: 600 14px/1.25 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1); } .ds-btn-gold:hover { background: var(--color-gold-light, #D4BA7A); } .ds-btn-gold:focus-visible { outline: auto; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Navy Primary Button
components.description: Primary booking action on white or ivory sales surfaces.

components.name: Outline Secondary Button
components.description: Secondary navigation action on a navy field.
components.css: .ds-dark-field { display: inline-block; padding: 20px; background: var(--color-navy, #0A1F3F); } .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-block; color: #fff; padding: 11px 31px; border: 1px solid rgb(255 255 255 / 30%); border-radius: 6px; font: 600 14px/1.25 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; transition: border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1); } .ds-btn-outline:hover { border-color: #fff; } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: auto; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Workshop Card
components.description: Canonical program summary with teal icon field and restrained elevation.
components.html:
◆

Mind Mastery for Peak Performance

Attention management, emotional regulation, clarity under pressure, and thought pattern optimization.

Learn more →
components.css: .ds-workshop-card { max-width: 420px; box-sizing: border-box; padding: 32px; color: var(--color-navy, #0A1F3F); background: #fff; border: 1px solid rgb(10 31 63 / 10%); border-radius: 8px; box-shadow: 0 1px 3px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 10%), 0 1px 2px -1px rgb(0 0 0 / 10%); font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: box-shadow 150ms cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1); } .ds-workshop-card:hover { box-shadow: 0 4px 6px -1px rgb(0 0 0 / 10%), 0 2px 4px -2px rgb(0 0 0 / 10%); } .ds-workshop-icon { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 40px; height: 40px; margin-bottom: 16px; border-radius: 9999px; color: var(--color-teal, #2A7F7F); background: rgb(42 127 127 / 10%); } .ds-workshop-card h3 { margin: 0 0 12px; font-size: 20px; line-height: 1.4; } .ds-workshop-card p { margin: 0 0 16px; color: rgb(10 31 63 / 60%); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.5; } .ds-workshop-card a { color: var(--color-teal, #2A7F7F); font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; text-decoration: none; } .ds-workshop-card a:hover { color: var(--color-teal-light, #3A9E9E); } .ds-workshop-card a:focus-visible { outline: auto; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Client Card
components.description: Compact proof tile for named corporate clients.
components.css: .ds-client-card { max-width: 360px; box-sizing: border-box; padding: 24px; color: var(--color-navy, #0A1F3F); background: #fff; border: 1px solid rgb(10 31 63 / 10%); border-radius: 8px; box-shadow: 0 1px 3px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 10%), 0 1px 2px -1px rgb(0 0 0 / 10%); font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: box-shadow 150ms cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1); } .ds-client-card:hover { box-shadow: 0 4px 6px -1px rgb(0 0 0 / 10%), 0 2px 4px -2px rgb(0 0 0 / 10%); } .ds-client-card h3 { margin: 0; font-size: 18px; line-height: 1.55; } .ds-client-card p { margin: 4px 0 0; color: rgb(10 31 63 / 50%); font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.25; }

components.name: Contact Method Tile
components.description: Quiet contact option with a circular teal icon field.
components.css: .ds-contact-tile { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 16px; max-width: 340px; padding: 16px; color: var(--color-navy, #0A1F3F); background: var(--color-cream, #F8F6F0); border-radius: 8px; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1); } .ds-contact-tile:hover { background: rgb(248 246 240 / 70%); } .ds-contact-icon { display: grid; place-items: center; flex: 0 0 40px; height: 40px; color: var(--color-teal, #2A7F7F); background: rgb(42 127 127 / 10%); border-radius: 9999px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-contact-tile strong, .ds-contact-tile small { display: block; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.4; } .ds-contact-tile strong { font-weight: 500; transition: color 150ms cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1); } .ds-contact-tile:hover strong { color: var(--color-teal, #2A7F7F); } .ds-contact-tile small { color: rgb(10 31 63 / 50%); } .ds-contact-tile:focus-visible { outline: auto; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Navigation
components.description: Sticky institutional navigation with gold state signaling.
components.html:
BAMS
HomeAboutWorkshops
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 32px; padding: 18px 24px; color: #fff; background: var(--color-navy, #0A1F3F); box-shadow: 0 10px 15px -3px rgb(0 0 0 / 10%), 0 4px 6px -4px rgb(0 0 0 / 10%); font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-nav-brand { color: #fff; font-weight: 700; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav div { display: flex; gap: 24px; } .ds-nav div a { color: rgb(255 255 255 / 90%); font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; text-decoration: none; transition: color 150ms cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1); } .ds-nav div a:hover, .ds-nav div .ds-nav-active { color: var(--color-gold, #C5A55A); } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: auto; outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview:
The system presents BAMS as a formal, historic institution that has evolved without discarding its authority. Deep navy establishes permanence, restrained gold signals heritage, and teal introduces the contemporary mind-management practice. Warm ivory keeps long sections approachable without turning the experience into consumer wellness branding.

The visual language is composed and conventional: centered page introductions, generous vertical rhythm, direct typography, modestly rounded controls, and orderly card grids. It should feel established before it feels fashionable. Avoid soft-focus spa language and generic startup-SaaS effects such as glass panels, playful gradients, or novelty UI treatments.
keyCharacteristics: Deep navy foundations with selective gold and teal accents
Clear Inter typography with bold, direct headings
Generous section spacing and restrained surface elevation
Institutional, solid components with modest rounding

rules.name: The Three Roles Rule
rules.body: Navy carries authority, teal identifies current expertise, and gold marks heritage or a high-priority action; do not interchange them casually.

rules.name: The Gold Restraint Rule
rules.body: Gold is an accent, not a large background field. Its scarcity preserves its institutional weight.

rules.name: The Single-Family Rule
rules.body: Use Inter across display, body, and labels; create hierarchy through scale and weight rather than decorative font switching.

rules.name: The Restrained Layers Rule
rules.body: Keep surfaces flat by default; use shadow to clarify interaction or persistent hierarchy, never as decoration.

dos: Do anchor major institutional surfaces in Executive Navy and use Warm Ivory to pace long pages.
Do reserve Heritage Gold for legacy cues, active navigation, bullets, and the highest-priority action.
Do use Restorative Teal for present-day programs, links, icons, and contemporary expertise.
Do keep section spacing generous and prose within readable 42–56rem measures.
Do preserve visible keyboard focus, strong text contrast, and responsive stacking.
donts: Don't drift into consumer-spa styling with pastel washes, soft-focus imagery, script typography, or spiritual motifs.
Don't imitate generic startup SaaS with glassmorphism, neon accents, playful gradients, or novelty dashboards.
Don't use gold as a dominant surface or treat all three brand colors as interchangeable accents.
Don't add heavy shadows, excessive rounding, or floating layers where borders and tonal separation suffice.
